authenticity_review: Upon reflection, I must adjust my authenticity score downward. The Router identified a structural collapse at the bill-face junction (severity 2.0) and texture anomalies on feathers (severity 1.5). I confirmed both. Crucially, the animal_pose_auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk level (53% low-confidence keypoints), specifically affecting the limbs and hips. Visually, the legs are indeed problematic: they appear unnaturally thin, lack clear joint definition, and seem to merge ambiguously with the rock shadow. This is not merely a pose estimation failure but likely reflects genuine anatomical generation errors. The combination of the smoothed bill-face junction, smudged feather textures, and structurally ambiguous legs constitutes multiple moderate-to-severe artifacts. My initial score of 2.85 was too lenient given the convergence of expert warnings and visual confirmation of defects across multiple body regions. A score closer to 2.0-2.3 better reflects the cumulative impact of these issues.
